label: Task-27
title: Add 'Create Issue from Error' button in Messages Panel
description:
Add a button to error messages that allows creating a new Bug issue directly from the error.

## User Story
As a developer, when I encounter an error in the UI, I want to quickly create a bug report with the error details pre-filled, so I can track and fix the issue later.

## Requirements
1. Add 'Create Bug' button to error messages
2. Button opens Create Issue modal with:
   - Type pre-selected as 'Bug'
   - Title pre-filled: error message summary
   - Description pre-filled with:
     - Error message
     - Stack trace
     - URL/endpoint
     - Reproduction context
3. User can edit before creating
4. Success feedback when bug is created

## UI Mockup
```
[ERROR] updateNode failed: Not Found      [x]
ERROR - just now
[Show Details] [Create Bug]
```

## Pre-filled Description Template
```markdown
## Error
updateNode failed: Not Found

## Stack Trace

## Context
- URL: PATCH /nodes/api/nodes/Bug-11
- Status: 404
- Time: 2024-02-02 10:15:32
- Version: v0.1.5
```

## Implementation
- Add button to error message template
- Create method to format error as bug description
- Open modal with pre-filled data
